content.text: Setting up a sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-honest-side-12|COREMERCH guide to solutions]]-west-africa-stack-started|The Digital]] store is a four-step sequence that most creators overcomplicate by starting in the wrong order. Step one is the backend: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles payment verification, order logging, and product delivery. Step two is the payment layer: NOWPayments connects your wallet addresses to the checkout flow — no KYC required from you or your buyer. Step three is the storefront: Cloudflare Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-what-16|github]] Pages serves your store for free with no server management. Step four is testing: complete a real mainnet transaction, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Only after step four passes cleanly should you promote the store. COREMERCH deploys the complete Edge Stack — Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments — in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure designed by COREMERCH empowers you to take ownership of your digital commerce. Conventional platforms often restrict access based on geographical location or payment methods. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages, you leverage a robust, flexible hosting solution that operates independently of these limitations. This architecture ensures you have complete control over your store, allowing for seamless transactions and delivery of digital products.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating your deployment, gather the necessary tools and accounts. You will need a Cloudflare account for hosting, a Google account for Apps Script, and a NOWPayments account for processing payments. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint to understand the deployment process. Ensure your digital products are ready to upload to your store, as this will streamline the setup and get your store operational quickly.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your backend with Google Apps Script, which will handle the business logic of your store. Next, configure NOWPayments to facilitate automatic crypto payment verification. This setup allows for smooth processing of transactions with over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring you can cater to a global audience. Finally, link your delivery system to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, allowing customers to access their purchases immediately upon payment confirmation.
Take control of your digital commerce with sovereign infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Test the functionality of your payment processing by making a small transaction yourself. This will help you ensure that everything is working as expected. After confirming that payments are processed smoothly, promote your store to your audience. Utilize social media and other channels to drive traffic to your digital store, highlighting the ease of payment with cryptocurrency.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store up and running, focus on scaling your operations. You can enhance your offerings by adding more products and utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack for advanced features. This includes configuring SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email authentication, which builds trust with your customers. Regularly monitor your store’s performance and make adjustments as necessary to ensure a seamless customer experience.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
No more restrictions; own your store, own your data.

Explore related topics such as hosting digital product stores on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. For those seeking a more comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a more robust setup with enhanced features. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store by using Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This combination allows you to operate without the limitations of traditional payment systems.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours to deploy. In contrast, Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, fully tested before handoff.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are viable options for hosting your digital product store. Each provides a flexible hosting solution that supports custom backend logic and payment processing.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, offering a wide range of options for your customers. This flexibility ensures you can cater to a global audience, enhancing your store's appeal.
How do I ensure my transactions are secure?

To secure your transactions, use NOWPayments for payment processing, which offers automatic verification. Additionally, implement SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email security to build trust with your customers.
